folder.title: Questionnaires, map traces, and campaign drafts.
folder.copy: A physical record of the Shanghai project: community research, the walking-time map, and information materials for food safety and anti-fraud awareness.
folder.note: The map and campaigns were designed from the research findings. They are not evidence of a measured long-term quality-of-life improvement.

components.meta: EMG DEVICE / HARDWARE ITERATION / REV. CURRENT
components.title: The enclosure had to shrink around the electronics.
components.copy: The hardware moved through physical constraints as well as signal processing: solder the signal path, position the ESP32 boards and battery, reserve access points, print a shell, then revise the enclosure around the components.
components.note: The model documents iterative packaging and internal component organization. It is a CAD prototype, not a finished manufactured enclosure.

envelope.title: A fractional allocation still needs a usable assignment.
envelope.copy: This packet keeps realization and evaluation beside the allocation mechanism. The work does not stop at a probability matrix; it also tests how a concrete assignment affects preference outcomes.
envelope.note: The percentages are reported results from the original presentation and should be rerun before being treated as reproducible benchmarks.
